visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright indoor living room. A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black turtleneck and light-wash blue jeans, is kneeling on a grey floor mat holding several red envelopes. A young boy in a red hoodie stands next to her, looking curious. A large light-colored dog is lying on the sofa nearby. (2) The woman fans out the red envelopes to show the boy and the camera. A small toddler in red is briefly seen running in the background. The room is filled with domestic items like a wicker shelf and various toys. (3) The woman encourages the boy to pick an envelope. He selects one, and she hands it to him with a cheerful expression. The lighting is consistent and bright throughout. (4) A smaller, fluffy dog enters the frame, and the woman playfully offers it a red envelope. The boy watches while holding his own envelope. (5) The woman holds up another envelope towards the camera, then points to the side while giving a thumbs up. A television is visible in the background showing a news broadcast.
